comment: Literals of the Core 2 rest site and its Smith that the web keeps in code (docs/design/11 WP-16; src/model/smithingCore.js, gameProfileRest.js, restRevisit.js, ui/components/gameProfileRest.js at the pinned sha b8cfe4fac). coreAuthor: the profile author whose runs level by skill alone (coreSkillOnlyProgression). simulationSeed: the seed of the throwaway fights the Smith's card rows are read from (createRng(17)). statOrder / statLabels: the item stat rows a tier step can change, in the order the receipt lists them, and their names. cardValues: the card figures the Smith follows (the op, its label and the rating that scales it). budgetLabels: the name of an armour's budget row and a shield's stat points row. consumedKinds / restedKinds: the services a left rest site remembers as spent / as a rest (restRevisit.js). restNodeTypes / restActualType: the map node types a rest service stands at. recoveryRows: the rows of the screen's recovery ledger (the pool, its run field and the flask charge field it refills). levelCurveDefaults: the base and growth the character level curve reads when the balance authors none. introServices: the services whose pair makes the arrival line say both are free.
